description: Fully responsive interactive What-If tool for teaching 'Preserving Equality: Performing Same Operations on Both Sides'. Features container-query-based responsive breakpoints (xs <380px, sm <520px, md <700px, lg 700px+), fluid SVG scale visualization, adaptive typography, and touch-friendly mobile interactions. Singularity Design System (Poppins, #4A4DC9/#FF7212/#533086). Learn mode with 7 animated steps. Practice mode with mixed MCQ, True/False, and Fill-in-the-Blank questions.
topic: Preserving Equality: Performing Same Operations on Both Sides
subject: Mathematics

designSystem.name: Singularity
designSystem.buttons: Pill-shaped (border-radius: 999px), contained gradient for primary CTAs, outlined for secondary
designSystem.cards: border-radius: 16px, subtle borders with tint colors

xs.description: Extra small phones (iPhone SE, small Android). Compact padding (12px), font sizes reduced (title 14px, body 11-12px), SVG scale 240px wide, navigation shows only arrows with numeric counter, buttons full-width, equation text uses word-break.

sm.description: Standard phones. Moderate padding (14px), title 14px, SVG 270px, nav shows arrows with abbreviated labels, buttons adapt to content width.

md.description: Large phones / small tablets. Standard padding (16-18px), title 15-16px, SVG 290px, full nav labels, step indicator dots shown.

lg.description: Tablets and desktop. Full padding (20px), title 17px, body 13px, SVG 310px, all UI elements at full size, step indicator dots with active expansion.

responsiveFeatures: Container-query-based breakpoints via ResizeObserver (not window width — works in iframes and embedded contexts)
SVG balance scale uses viewBox with percentage-based width for fluid scaling
Font sizes, paddings, gaps, and icon sizes adapt per breakpoint
Equation text uses word-break: break-all to prevent horizontal overflow
Navigation buttons collapse text labels on xs (arrows only + step counter)
Step indicator dots replaced by numeric 'X/Y' counter on xs screens
True/False buttons stack horizontally but with reduced padding on mobile
MCQ options use flex-start alignment for multiline text on small screens
Check Answer and Next buttons go full-width on mobile for easier tap targets
Fill-in-blank input scales width from 130px (mobile) to 160px (desktop)
inputMode='numeric' on fill-in-blank for mobile numeric keyboard
Container uses margin: 0 auto and width: 100% with maxWidth for centering
Border-radius reduces from 20px (lg) to 14px (mobile) for compact feel
Header description shortens on mobile for space efficiency
learning_objectives: Understand that performing the same operation on both sides preserves equality
Visualize equation balance using a weighing scale analogy
Recognize that different operations on different sides breaks equality
Apply inverse operations to systematically solve linear equations
Use the balance principle across addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division
instructions_for_student: Performing the same operation on both sides of an equation preserves equality. Different operations on different sides breaks it.
teaching_notes: Guide students through this interactive tool. Encourage exploration and discussion. Start with Learn mode for conceptual understanding, then switch to Practice for mixed assessment. The tool is fully responsive — works on classroom projectors, tablets, and student phones.

width.description: Max width of container. Tool is fluid within this — will shrink to fit any screen.

height.description: Min height on desktop. On mobile, height is auto to avoid scrollbar issues.

showStepIndicator.description: On xs screens, automatically replaced by numeric counter regardless of this setting

themeColor.description: Note: Singularity DS colors are hardcoded in the DS token object for consistency

learn.description: 7 interactive steps: intro → balance principle (interactive demo) → add/subtract/multiply-divide examples → breaking equality → solving equations walkthrough

practice.description: 10 randomized questions: ~3 MCQ + ~4 True/False + ~3 Fill-in-Blank from a 20-question bank. Score tracking, hints, explanations, retry.

generation_prompt: What-If tool where students start with a balanced equation and choose an operation to apply to both sides. Shows whether equality is preserved. Can also try applying to one side only to see imbalance.
